description: The file defines a ASP.NET Core MVC controller named FollowersController, responsible for handling follow and unfollow actions for user profiles. It uses MediatR to send commands for adding and deleting followers, and includes authorization via JWT scheme.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core MVC controller handling follow and unfollow profile actions using MediatR commands and JWT authorization.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST requests to follow a user profile identified by username, using Mediator to send an Add.Command.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile identified by username, using Mediator to send a Delete.Command.
